parsed.rationale: I disagree with the team's acute STEMI read: this is sinus rhythm at about 65 bpm with a narrow QRS and normal intervals, and the tall upright T waves in V2-V3 have at most about 1 mm of J-point elevation, below the 2 mm STEMI threshold for V2-V3, with no ST elevation in two contiguous leads elsewhere and no reciprocal ST depression.
